All thirteen episodes from the second season of Camp Snoopy are now available on Apple TV. Watch the trailer below.

Snoopy’s back on Apple TV

Continuing Apple TV’s long-running partnership with Peanuts, the service has now premiered the second season of Camp Snoopy.

The first season, which premiered in 2024, featured 13 episodes following the Beagle Scouts’ efforts to save their troop while Charlie Brown and his friends spent the summer at Camp Spring Lake.

For the show’s second season, here’s what Apple TV says subscribers can expect:

The second season of Camp Snoopy joins several Peanuts original series and specials, as well as the entire classic Peanuts library. Apple’s partnership with Peanuts has also expanded beyond streaming, bringing Snoopy to the Apple Watch through a dedicated watch face and to Apple TV through animated screen savers.

You can watch the trailer for Camp Snoopy season 2 below:

Apple TV is available for $12.99 per month and features hit TV shows and movies like Severance, The Studio, The Morning Show, Shrinking and Silo.
